interpretation: R and L best beat B0 across all5 recorded metrics by scene-bootstrap intervals; J best improves AbsRel/RMSE/delta1/boundary-band AbsRel, but its F1 difference from B0 is inconclusive.

L versus R best improves AbsRel/RMSE/F1/boundary-band error; delta1 interval crosses zero. J versus L best has inconclusive overall3 metrics, lower F1 and lower boundary-band error; the latter two signs hold for all3 seeds.

100 to200 best AbsRel improves for R,L,J, with intervals below zero. R improves all5 metrics; L improves overall3/F1 but worsens boundary-band error; J improves overall3/boundary-band error but worsens F1. Counts also increase scene coverage from100 to187.
None of these9 training runs satisfies the predeclared terminal-stability criterion. Their final scores remain reported, but the stable-final subset is empty rather than a zero score.

L200 seed320112 final retains similar AbsRel but loses boundary F1: 0.4818895 to0.3458046;598images worsen/32improve/24tie, and zero-edge predictions rise18 to66. This is consistent with the previously frozen validation endpoint degradation, and is visible in all3 fixed test samples.

L200 final mean F1 is below B0 and R, but that mean is dominated by seed320112; other two seeds remain above B0/R. Likewise J-final F1 beating L-final in the seed-average is not a robust all-seed gain (one positive/two negative paired signs).

R final worsens overall3 and F1 versus best but improves boundary-band error for all3 seeds. J final changes are mixed: seed320112 and320114 improve F1, seed320113 worsens; mean F1/RMSE/delta1 degrade by scene intervals, but AbsRel and boundary-band changes are inconclusive.

Image-level results include clear counterexamples: kitchen0770 has worse overall AbsRel than B0; dining1449 L-final improves AbsRel while visibly losing boundaries. Aggregate accuracy improvement does not imply universal edge recovery.
No causal training-instability explanation is proven by endpoint comparisons; models and thresholds remain frozen.
